tools.name: list_packs
tools.description: Lists every live Collector Crypt graded-card pack with price, category, chance of each rarity, card value range per rarity, buyback rate, average value per dollar and popularity (pulls in the last 7 days), most popular first. Use it first to compare packs or to find a pack code; use get_pack for one

tools.name: get_pack
tools.description: Shows one pack in detail: odds and value range per rarity, buyback rate, how many cards of each rarity are left, and the 10 most valuable cards in its pool right now with the chance per pack of pulling each one. Use it when the user names or picks a pack; use list_packs to compare packs and estimate

tools.name: search_cards
tools.description: Finds Rare and Epic cards sitting in any pack's pool right now by name words and/or minimum value (e.g. 'charizard psa 10'), up to 25, most valuable first, with the pack each is in and the chance per pack of pulling that exact card. Use it when the user asks whether a card can be pulled or which pac

tools.name: get_card
tools.description: Shows one Rare or Epic card that is in a pack pool right now: name, insured value, picture, and every pack it can come from with that pack's price and the chance per pack of pulling this exact card. Use it after search_cards, passing the nft field of a result; use search_cards when you only have a c

tools.name: list_recent_pulls
tools.description: Lists the newest pack openings on Collector Crypt across every site that sells its packs, newest first (from the latest ~200): card, insured value, rarity, pack and its price, how many times the pack price the card was worth, and when. tools.name: estimate_budget
tools.description: Estimates what spending a budget on one pack usually returns: how many packs it buys, the average insured value pulled, the average cash back if every card is sold back, the average result, and the chance of at least one Rare or Epic.
